provider: Federal Office of Meteorology and Climatology MeteoSwiss / Federal Spatial Data Infrastructure

request_contract.parameter_rules: One manually opted-in, anonymous, fixed HTTPS GET of https://data.geo.admin.ch/api/stac/v1/collections/ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-radar-derived-grid, with no query, redirects, credentials, retries, free-form host, catalogue pagination, /items, /assets, downloads, NetCDF bytes, or high-frequency polling. Fail closed on URL, provider identity, STAC version, collection title/ID, CC-BY licence and exact self/items links; do not follow links or select an individual hail product.

response_contract.format: One exact 1.0.0 STAC Collection JSON (metadata only) for ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-radar-derived-grid with original CC-BY licence, MeteoSwiss producer/licensor, original provider self/items links and descriptions; no assets or data values downloaded.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: The collection contains several non-interchangeable radar-derived hail climate product families: monthly/yearly MESHS and anomalies, monthly/yearly hail-day counts and anomalies, long-term hail-day climatologies and standard deviations, and separate HailStoRe-derived return-value hazard maps. Hail fields are radar/algorithm-derived pseudo-observations rather than comprehensive ground measurements; return-value maps additionally depend on stochastic resampling and represent annual exceedance hazard under today's climate, not observed event catalogues. A hail day uses the provider-defined 06 UTC to 06 UTC window. The hail-climatology datasets are calculated only for the April-through-September hail season; absence or non-publication for October through March must not be interpreted as an observed zero, a verified no-hail day or month, or complete year-round observational coverage. Monthly and yearly products update over time, while return-value maps are static. Data are provided on the Swiss LV95 / EPSG:2056 grid at approximately 1 km scale. Any later asset consumer must preserve exact product class, temporal/release identity, observed-versus-model-derived status and CRS rather than treating the collection as one homogeneous hail variable.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: MeteoSwiss published open-data terms and FSDI service conditions permit registration-free fair-use access but explicitly warn against high-intensity scraping and excessive duplicate downloads. This contract permits one explicit manual metadata-only GET, no schedule and no download of NetCDF assets. Any additional event/return-level product retrieval needs its own scope and cadence review.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: The STAC collection metadata and current monthly/yearly item inventory are mutable as MeteoSwiss publishes updates. Provider documentation states monthly updates are available after the following month and yearly updates at the end of October, while hail-hazard return values are static. Any future asset receipt must bind retrieval UTC, exact collection/item/asset identity, final provider URL, byte count and SHA-256.

rights_and_policy.notes: MeteoSwiss Open Data terms explicitly allow commercial reuse of this dataset with source attribution ('Source: MeteoSwiss') under CC BY 4.0, and FSDI separately permits anonymous, fair-use STAC metadata access; no numeric quota is assumed for this repository. This reviewed access is narrowly confined to one opt-in STAC Collection metadata GET. It does not confer CAT-model admission, license rights to third-party linked assets, annual event data semantics or permission for repeat bulk downloads.

expected_evidence: One original HTTPS 200 STAC Collection JSON with no redirects and strict 256-KiB response cap
Frozen STAC version 1.0.0 and collection ID ch.meteoschweiz.ogd-radar-derived-grid
Original title Spatial climate analyses - Hail, MeteoSwiss producer/licensor and CC-BY collection licence
Original self and items links have the exact official FSDI collection URL and paths; do not follow them
UTC retrieval timestamp, original raw response SHA-256, exact request SHA-256 and running script SHA-256
No data assets, NetCDF values, original payload persistence, CAT-model scientific or commercial asset admission

notes: One explicitly dispatched reviewed STAC Collection metadata GET is now enabled; no STAC Items request, NetCDF/asset file acquisition, hail return-period event set or insurer-loss model input is authorized. Hail datasets are radar-derived, seasonal April–September, and climatological return periods are not historical events.
